# Vocabulary.com

> > An interactive English learning platform combining a comprehensive dictionary with adaptive word games and educational tools for vocabulary improvement.

Vocabulary.com helps students and educators build stronger vocabularies through personalized learning experiences, competitive word games like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam, and detailed word definitions with example sentences. The platform uses adaptive learning technology to tailor word challenges to individual skill levels.
